name: Caissa Fianchetto
source:
A rare king-ranked Esper, Caissa is a man who is cold, calculating, and ruthless - at least on the surface. There could be surprising warmth waiting for those who get past his frigid barriers. Or maybe, underneath it all, he really is as coldblooded as he seems.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/steamberrystudio/gilded-shadows-a-gxb-sci-fi-adventure-otome-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
